page: Microsoft Azure FX32-8mds_v2 is a constrained-core virtual machine configuration within the compute-intensive and memory-dense FXmdsv2 family, managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at a base clock speed of 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware acceleration includes 260 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction sets for AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and VAES cryptography. The platform features an asymmetric memory ratio, pairing 672.0 GB of system RAM (84.0 GB per vCPU) with 1,888 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage. Hardware accelerators like GPUs are not present.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier single-core CPU throughput, supported by high clock frequency and deep cache. Geekbench single-core testing reached 2,352.0 points (top 10%), with text processing at 2,945.0 points. Single-threaded compression benchmarks also demonstrated strong performance, yielding 34.73 GB/sec in gzip compression and 14.39 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. However, aggregate multi-threaded capabilities reflect the limited 8-vCPU allocation, with Geekbench multi-core scoring 8,736.0 points and stress-ng multi-core testing placing in the middle 50%. Text generation and prompt processing for medium to large language models exhibit low throughput due to the absence of dedicated matrix accelerators and restricted core count.

The primary architectural tradeoff of the FX32-8mds_v2 lies in its constrained-core sizing. By restricting active compute to 8 vCPUs while retaining a full 672.0 GB memory footprint and high single-thread clock rates, the instance reduces per-core software licensing overhead without forfeiting large in-memory capacities or fast ephemeral NVMe disk I/O. The hardware profile is aligned with memory-intensive workloads requiring high per-core licensing efficiency, including relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers such as Redis, electronic design automation (EDA), and batch data processing jobs with high RAM requirements.
description: Microsoft Azure FX32-8mds_v2 is a specialized constrained-core virtual machine powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores) on the x86_64 architecture. Designed for memory-dense and high single-thread workloads, it features an extensive 672.0 GB RAM allocation, 260 MB of L3 cache, and 1,888 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, without GPU hardware. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-threaded performance, reaching 2,352.0 in Geekbench single-core and strong compression metrics, while overall multi-core throughput sits in the median range due to the low core count. This instance profile offers significant cost efficiency for workloads governed by per-core software licensing, such as enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caches, and electronic design automation tools requiring substantial RAM and local storage speeds.
